integrity: Analytic proof and standard-library exact-rational verifier are supplied. Finite tests supplement rather than replace proof; independent audit has not been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to Gaussian targets with SPD drift and isotropic Brownian diffusion, exact subflows and iid common ordering Bernoulli choices.
Covariance minimaxity does not imply minimax distributional accuracy, asymptotic variance or computational cost.
An equivalent specialist random-order Gaussian stationary result may exist outside inspected literature.
title: Spectral minimax calibration and unavoidable fourth-order dependence in random-order Langevin splitting
